text.text: Log each session, add the sets, and let the totals build up. Personal bests show on every exercise.
Reusable layouts to copy into a new workout.
Pick a routine, start a new workout from the template, and log each set. The numbers below are examples, not prescriptions.
Too easy for three sessions in a row: add a set or a few pounds.
Too hard to finish: drop a set, keep the movements.
Short on time: do the first two exercises and the mobility finish.
Look at the Heaviest set column on Exercises and the volume per workout. Progress rarely moves in a straight line; compare months, not days.
Where did effort stay high with no gain?
What is the one focus for next month?
Bench press heaviest set up 10 lb. Leg day effort stayed at 9 with no gain: add a rest day before it. Next month: two mobility sessions, keep the long run on weekends.
